classification: exploratory ranking, not a statistical noninferiority test
eligibility: no confirmed major prototype semantic failure
noninferiority_rule: per seed candidate >= NOOBJ-2 AND candidate >= Gate0-2
ranking: prefer benefit direction nonnegative in both seeds against matched ACT and Gate0
report paired differences and uncertainty; no posthoc metric substitution
tie_rule: if mean rates differ by <=.04 retain up to2 candidates, do not force unique winner
if_no_reliable_gain: KEEP_ORIGINAL or INCONCLUSIVE; not proof zero optimal
cross_task: task-equal aggregation, never treat50 starts as50 tasks
